reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

common.F029_forward: The named concurrent/distributed use needs the actual admitted interleavings, communication, faults, memory and recovery semantics. An appropriate model can establish a partial protocol/observation/accounting fact at that scope, while a changed implementation/world requires a separate correspondence argument.
common.F029_reverse: The native function and named interaction select which actors, faults, event order, memory and recovery behavior the model must include. They determine the intended safety/progress question without demanding deployment evidence for a legitimate model-only result.
common.F030_forward: The named shared-object, transaction or client-history use receives the exact ordering/observation criterion it needs. Linearizability requires a legal sequential history respecting real-time precedence with proper incomplete-operation treatment; serializability and other refinements have their own units and criteria. A valid chosen local history guarantee can be a partial input without global progress or full mission closure.
common.F030_reverse: The native consumer selects the actual operation/transaction boundary, observed results and ordering condition. It can show that a weaker serialized or causal criterion is enough, or that ignoring real time loses the needed property. It does not establish an implementation satisfies that criterion.
common.F031_forward: The specified monitor/log-query observation can supply exactly its event/value/finite-trace verdict as a useful native input. Its coverage, ordering, time and missing-event semantics bound the result. A decisive positive witness is possible for a suitable property; no-observed-violation does not by itself establish every actual event or future run.
common.F031_reverse: The native question selects the observed event/value and the verdict meaning that matters. It distinguishes a useful narrow observation from an unneeded global closure requirement and identifies the missing-event/time assumptions needed for a stronger inference.
common.F032_forward: Interpret the named monitor under its actual advisory, diagnostic or preventing role and current property/event semantics. Useful passive evidence does not require action authority. A prevention claim additionally needs timely observation and a real controlled action path; a stale or reinterpreted event cannot inherit a former currentness claim.
common.F032_reverse: The native use selects the monitor role, semantic version/context, relevant interval and whether intervention is actually required. It supplies the criterion for current bounded evidence and avoids imposing fail-closed/recovery duties on an adequate advisory detector.
common.negative_forward: In the individually stated inspected use, the actual partial-input calculation/model/criterion has no concurrent-protocol or shared-object/transaction-history obligation of this method. The source supplies no identified premise to that inference. This is a scoped nonmatch after examining actual partial uses, not a conclusion from failure to prove the entire native property.
common.negative_reverse: The named native scalar, static or sequential use supplies no actual interleaving/communication model or operation/transaction legality criterion for this source method. A concrete new concurrent implementation/consumer can create a later relation; an unspecified future collector, wrapper or controller is not inferred.
common.negative_reentry: Re-enter on an actually specified concurrent actor/operation/transaction interface and consequential observation/order/fault requirement. Distinguish a genuine new use from a property-title resemblance or an ordinary sequential computation that already closes the selected question.
common.controls: F/C16 checks complete finite register histories and real-time versus freely chosen sequential order; its pending-operation argument is separately semantic, not run through that enumerator. F/C17 changes a toy store-buffer model and changes reachable outcomes. F/C10 retains passive detection, a co-safety positive witness, missing-event and delayed-alarm countercases. Root r2/M1/M2/M3 separate observed-prefix truth, capability and policy utility. None is an industrial execution or independent replication.
common.bounds: A protocol/model result is legitimate at its own scope. Linearizability is not lock-freedom, deadline, statistical independence, physical fault containment or authorization. A monitor can be semantically exact about its event and imperfect about a target function. Declared statistical/physical premises remain separate.
common.cost_alternatives: Use an externally serialized component, immutable batch calculation, ordinary local return, short log query, direct finite check or existing adequate abstraction when sufficient. Include instrumentation/load, false-positive intervention, synchronization and maintenance costs. No global ordering, continuous monitoring or enforcement bundle is mandatory.
common.execution: Own exposed analytical mappings to exact current native roles and already inspected/recorded cases. No new concurrent program, hardware test, monitor, checker, target deployment or physical experiment executes.
